findings.statement: No exact match for a business trading as 'Killer Chicken' at killer-chicken.com. Checked by web search on 2026-10-09. This environment has no direct web fetch (DNS resolution is unavailable to the agent, confirmed against a control domain), so page-level and registry checks could not be performed — only search-index evidence. City/state were also unavailable: the warehouse pull did not carry LEGAL_ENTITY_ADDRESS_CITY/STATE until the 2026-10-09 change, which takes effect on the next pull. A US LLC is registered at state level, so without a state the registry check cannot be run at all.

The account uses info@killer-chicken.com. Whether that domain resolves, who registered it and when COULD NOT BE DETERMINED: this environment cannot resolve DNS for any host, verified against a control domain, so an earlier apparent 'domain does not exist' result was an artefact of the sandbox and has been discarded. No risk points assigned.

evidenceNeeded: Resolve killer-chicken.com and capture registrar, creation date and registrant — a domain registered days before onboarding would be material.
Confirm the restaurant exists at a real address with a food licence.
Review the first transaction (2026-10-09, $0.55) — consistent with a card test.
summary: The only merchant in this cohort using a non-consumer email domain, but the domain could not be checked from this environment and no business of this name was found. The domain check is the single highest-value outstanding item and is explicitly NOT recorded as a finding either way.
